## Goal
- Complete the "FINAL IVX CAPITAL PLATFORM COMPLETION — EXECUTE, VERIFY, DEPLOY" mandate: run real Phase 8 QA, fix all failures, deploy, and produce verified evidence across all 10 phases. Then audit + fix IVX IA chat routing bugs per owner's new request — make IVX IA an enterprise senior developer. Then audit + fix owner chat opening on months-old messages instead of the latest turn.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION, CONFIRM_IVX_SENSITIVE_OPERATION, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD
- No fake data, no placeholder progress, no misleading certifications
- `package.json` cannot be edited directly — must use Install tool
- Working directory: /home/user/rork-app; use `bun x` not `npx`
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — large files >~30KB MUST use gzip-base64; Python `zlib.compress(raw, 9, 31)` (wbits=31 = gzip format, NOT wbits=15 = deflate which causes "incorrect header check"); omit `contentEncoding` for small files
- Render deploy API: same action endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST /api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login; length ~1620; expires frequently — re-mint as needed; refreshToken at `/tmp/owner_rt`)
- `/tmp/` files get wiped by sandbox resets — recreate via heredoc each time
- Watchman refuses to start in low-priority sandbox (nice_value=19) — must exclude from PATH via `/tmp/nowatch` dir with shim script that exits 1
- Generated TypeScript code embedded inside outer template literals is DANGEROUS — `${...}` in generated code is eagerly evaluated by outer template → ReferenceError → worker crash. MUST use array-join with string concatenation instead.
- `pkill` commands cause shell exit code 128 in this sandbox — use `kill -9 <pid>` or `ps -ef | grep` + manual kill instead
- `bun test backend/` = 1495 tests across 110 files (~3.4s); `bunx tsc --noEmit` at root for full typecheck
- Gradle builds exceed 60s tool timeout — must run with `nohup env PATH=/tmp/nowatch:$PATH ./gradlew assembleRelease --build-cache --stacktrace > /tmp/gradle-build-1.4.13.log 2>&1 &` then poll PID + log tail + APK mtime/size
- APK presign upload API: `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` returns `uploadUrl` (900s expiry); PUT raw bytes with `Content-Type: application/vnd.android.package-archive`; S3 ETag matches local md5 when successful

- **IVX IA CHAT ROUTING FIX #1 — "fix server crash" — COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + LIVE-VERIFIED**: Commits `4e7d1096` + `c66e7454`. Live test → `model: ivx_self_developer_runtime`.

- **IVX IA CHAT ROUTING FIX #2 — "create and show me" — COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + LIVE-VERIFIED**: Commits `71b2076` + `7764ae4` + `da0123c` + `11cbbc7`. 3-way SHA parity at `11cbbc7d1eb5a84acd2b3d2196fca48878c1a0f5`.

Root cause: `resolveOwnerDevelopmentActionIntent` matched "deploy live" → `public_deploy` before senior-developer path. Fix: added enterprise override at TOP of `resolveOwnerDevelopmentActionIntent` in BOTH `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` and `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxAIRequestService.ts`. Commits: `28eaa1d` + `4eb24b1` + `0ea293d` + `7e14c0c` + `2ef3b0a`.

- **IVX IA CHAT ROUTING FIX #4 — plural/past-tense regex + APK v1.4.12(44) REBUILD — CODE + TESTS + COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + APK BUILT + UPLOADED + LIVE-VERIFIED**: Owner sent new screenshots showing app STILL broken — prompt "why my chats disappeared" not matched because old regex `\b(chat|...|disappear|disappearing|...)\b` did NOT match "chats" (plural) or "disappeared" (past tense) due to `\b` word boundary. Fix: strengthened regex to `/\b(chat(?:s|ting)?|...|disappear(?:ed|ing|s|ance)?|despair(?:ing|ed)?|vanish(?:es|ed|ing)?|...)\b/` in BOTH `backend/api/ivx-owner-ai.ts` AND `expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxAIRequestService.ts`. Bumped to v1.4.12(44). Backend tests 1495 pass / 0 fail. APK v1.4.12(44): 84,539,452 bytes, md5 `45dda3117643c809617d2a052e036b27`, live at https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.12.apk, S3 ETag matches local md5 ✓. 3-way SHA parity at `6be7ab755dd83e9c37588237a2875c8e4fe8f992`. Live test with exact screenshot prompt returned `model: ivx_self_developer_runtime`, `source: local_runtime`, task ID `ivx-worker-45eab594-15d4-4af7-b72b-447fdca3b432` — routing bug fixed.

- **IVX OWNER CHAT OPEN-ON-LATEST FIX 2026-07-19 — AUDITED + IMPLEMENTED + TESTS + COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + 3-WAY SHA PARITY VERIFIED**: Owner sent screenshots showing chat opens on months-old messages instead of the latest turn. Root cause audited in `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`: `pendingInitialScrollRef` was a ref cleared after ONE attempt; if the first `scrollToEnd`/`scrollToIndex` failed silently (FlatList hadn't measured dynamic bubbles yet), viewport stayed at top. FIX: (1) converted `pendingInitialScrollRef` from `useRef` to React state `initialScrollPending`/`setInitialScrollPending`; (2) added dedicated retry `useEffect` that polls up to 8 attempts (Android 180ms, iOS 80ms) calling `scrollToBottomRobust(false)` until `isAtBottomRef.current` is true or maxAttempts reached; (3) initial conversation-switch effect now depends on `displayedMessages` (not just `messages.length`) and no longer calls `scrollToBottomRobust` itself; (4) `onContentSizeChange` + `onLayout` keep calling `scrollToBottomRobust` while pending is true, don't clear it themselves; (5) `handleMessageListScroll` clears `initialScrollPending` once `atBottom` becomes true. Files: `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`. Bumped to v1.4.13(45). Backend tests 1495 pass / 0 fail. `bun x tsc --noEmit` 0 errors. Commits: `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx` → `3a76f180ff9f2b1ba34c40a8544ff76180bcd96a`, `expo/app.config.ts` → `0681c8cdcdd4a9a4aa58767c19e35ebae398a4d3`, `expo/android/app/build.gradle` → `c278e80800c8b8d69d40a927b10cc5d4b48487ff`. Render deploy triggered (accepted, serviceId `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`). 3-way SHA parity verified: GitHub HEAD `c278e80800c8b8d69d40a927b10cc5d4b48487ff` = Runtime `c278e80800c8b8d69d40a927b10cc5d4b48487ff`. Plan file `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md` updated with completion entry.

APK output expected at `expo/android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk`. Build marker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_19_BUILD_45_IVX_CHAT_OPEN_ON_LATEST_FIX`. ## Key Decisions
- Converted `pendingInitialScrollRef` from ref to React state `initialScrollPending` because refs don't trigger re-renders and a single retry can fail silently; state + dedicated retry effect lets the component keep polling until the FlatList actually reports it is at the bottom, matching WhatsApp/iMessage open-on-latest UX
- Initial conversation-switch effect dependency changed from `messages.length` to `displayedMessages` because `displayedMessages` is what the FlatList actually renders; using `messages.length` could fire before displayed set was computed
- Retry effect caps at 8 attempts (~1.5s Android) to avoid infinite loops while covering the Android measurement delay window
- expo/package.json remains at 1.4.8 because the system blocks direct `package.json` edits (must use Install tool); version is bumped in `app.config.ts` and `android/app/build.gradle` instead — these are what the Expo/Gradle build actually reads

## Next Steps

- Compute md5/sha256 of new APK; presign upload to `apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.13.apk` via `/api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD`; PUT raw bytes to S3
- Verify live URL HEAD https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.13.apk — confirm Content-Length + ETag == local md5
- Report APK md5/size/public URL to owner as proof
- Update plan file with APK upload confirmation if needed

- APK upload flow proven on v1.4.12: presign returns `uploadUrl` good for 900s; PUT without `Content-MD5` header works because S3 uses `UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD`; `Content-MD5` header causes HTTP 403 (signature mismatch); ETag in PUT response equals md5 of bytes
- Gradle build cached most tasks UP-TO-DATE; only `app:createBundleReleaseJsAndAssets` + downstream app tasks rerun on chat.tsx change (expected; ~30s Metro bundle + ~30s packaging)
